# Team plan and credits

## What to build

Give each team space its own plan and model credit balance through the existing billing UI. Billing and credits already belong to an `Organization`, and a team space is the only space of its own team organization, so the plan picker, credits and paywall already resolve to the team org when the team space is active (`organizationForMember({ spaceId: actor.spaceId, userId })`). This slice: lets any member (not only owners) manage billing in a team organization, writes an audit event for every billing change, makes sure a new team space on a hosted instance lands on the plan picker for that team space (and never touches the member's personal plan), and confirms self-hosted instances without billing skip the step.

## Decisions baked in

- In an organization whose space is `kind: "team"`, `managedOrganization` accepts any member (`isOwner` not required). Personal organizations are unchanged.
- Audit actions (via `recordAuditEvent`, actor = user, `organizationId` = team org): `billing.checkout.started`, `billing.portal.opened`, `billing.credits.purchased` (if there is a credit purchase path), `billing.mode.changed` (credits/byok). No amounts or card details in metadata beyond a plan/price id.
- Seat pricing does not change. Do not alter how checkout quantity is computed (`organizationSeatCount`); if it already uses member count, leave it and say so in a code comment only if one is missing.
- Mobile has no plan picker; nothing to add there.

Already in the codebase: `Space.kind` (`"private" | "team"`); `spaces.createTeam` (`apps/api/src/routes/spaces.ts`) creates the team org + space; the web Create menu has **New team space**, which on success calls `selectSpace(spaceId)` and navigates to `/app` (`apps/web/src/pages/shell/shell-dialogs.tsx`).

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/api/src/billing.ts` 102 and 274 (`modelCreditsEnabled`), 118-131 (`organization(actor)` via `organizationForMember`; `managedOrganization` requires `isOwner`, else `FORBIDDEN`), and every handler that calls `managedOrganization`.
- `packages/db/src/billing.ts` 17-52 (`hasModelAccess`, `spaceHasModelAccess`), 193-199 (`organizationSeatCount`), 201-218 (`organizationForMember`, `isOwnerRole`).
- `packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma` 237-260 (`BillingAccount`, `seats`), 1950-1963 (`ModelCreditAccount`), 1996-2016 (`BillingAuditEvent` — existing provider-side billing audit; keep it, add `AuditEvent` rows for user actions).
- `packages/db/src/audit-events.ts` 19-72 (`recordAuditEvent`).
- `apps/api/src/billing.postgres.test.ts`, `apps/api/src/billing-checkout.postgres.test.ts`, `apps/api/src/byok-plan.postgres.test.ts` — existing billing test setup (fake billing provider).
- `apps/web/src/components/SubscriptionGate.tsx` 24-32, 62-95, 135-150 — capabilities check (`!capabilities.billing || !me.billingEnabled` → open), `rpc.billing.status()` with the selected space header, full `PaywallPage` when no access, `?plans` dialog, `useBilling().showPlans`.
- `apps/web/src/pages/shell/shell-sidebar.tsx` 293-322 ("Upgrade" when `billing.canManage`), `apps/web/src/pages/SettingsOverlay.tsx` 98, 407 (billing section when `billingEnabled`).
- `apps/web/src/lib/rpc.ts` 18-56 (`selectedSpaceId`, `withSpaceHeaders`) — billing calls follow the selected space.
- Self-hosted detection: `packages/adapters/src/stripe-billing.ts` 892-907 (`stripeBillingConfigFromEnv` undefined without Stripe env), `apps/api/src/app.ts` 459-478, 849 (`billing: Boolean(billing)` capability), `apps/api/src/routes/shared.ts` 71 (`Me.billingEnabled`).

## Step-by-step tasks

### UPDATE `apps/api/src/billing.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `managedOrganization` allows any member when the org's space is `kind: "team"` (load via `space.findFirst({ where: { organizationId, kind: "team" } })` or extend `organizationForMember` to return `isTeam`); emit the audit events in the checkout/portal/credits/mode handlers.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/api check`

### UPDATE `packages/db/src/billing.ts` (if extending `organizationForMember`) and export changes.

### VERIFY/UPDATE web flow
- **IMPLEMENT**: after creating a team space with billing enabled, the selected space is the team space and `SubscriptionGate` re-evaluates `billing.status()` for it, showing the paywall/plan picker for the team org. If the gate caches status across space switches, key it by selected space id so switching back to the personal space shows the personal plan. Self-hosted (no billing): no plan step. No new copy.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/web check && pnpm --filter @rakazo/web test`

### TESTS
- `apps/api/src/team-billing.postgres.test.ts` (with the fake billing provider used in `billing-checkout.postgres.test.ts`): create a team space (owner A), add member B (insert `member` + `space_members` rows); B calls `billing.status` and starts checkout in the team space → allowed, provider called with the team org's customer, `billing.checkout.started` audit row; assert A's personal org billing is untouched; in a personal org a non-owner still gets `FORBIDDEN` (insert a second `member` with role `member` to a personal org to test the unchanged rule); credits reserved for a team-space run come from the team org account.
- Web unit test for `SubscriptionGate` re-checking status when the selected space changes (if changed).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A team space has its own plan and credit balance, separate from each member's personal plan.
- [ ] Any member of a team org can open the plan picker and manage billing; personal orgs keep owner-only.
- [ ] Every billing change by a user writes an audit event.
- [ ] Self-hosted instances without billing create team spaces with no plan step.

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm db:generate
pnpm check --affected || pnpm check
pnpm lint
pnpm exec vitest run apps/api/src apps/web/src/components
pnpm test:integration -- --spec=team-billing
```

## Project rules that apply (from AGENTS.md)

- Public repo: no secrets, real emails or private URLs in code, tests or fixtures. Test emails use `@rakazo.test`.
- Use top-level `import type`, never inline type imports. Dynamic `import()` only for deferred loading.
- Migrations must work with the previous release running side by side: only add tables/columns (nullable or with a default). Never drop or rename in this task. Folder name `packages/db/prisma/migrations/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS_snake_name/migration.sql`; use a timestamp after `20261110120000` and unique to this task (the suffix in this task's text). First line is a comment such as `-- Additive: older releases never read or write these columns.`
- Every table with row-level security must be listed in `ROW_SECURITY_MODELS` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:96`), enforced by `packages/db/src/row-security.postgres.test.ts:789-799`. New tables follow `packages/db/prisma/migrations/20261109120000_audit_events/migration.sql:57-60` (ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY + a `_system` policy on `current_setting('app.rls_bypass', true) = 'on'`) and `20261022120000_row_level_security_tenant_tables` for tenant policies.
- Database access in tests and app code must run inside `runAsTenant` / `runAsSystem` (`packages/db/src/row-security.ts:27-40`); the vitest setup (`packages/testkit/src/pin-test-env.ts`) fails a suite that touches the database outside them.
- Tests are deterministic and offline. Postgres suites are `*.postgres.test.ts`, skipped unless `VERIFY_DATABASE=1` and `DATABASE_URL` are set (`describe.skipIf(!enabled).sequential(...)`, see `apps/api/src/board-rename.postgres.test.ts:10-13`).
- The API owns authorization and validation; frontends express intent and render state.
- Keep UI copy minimal: no explainer text that repeats the interface. Colors only via `@rakazo/ui-tokens` semantic tokens; reuse `packages/ui-web` components.
- Coordinate across instances through Postgres (transactions, advisory locks, claims), never in-process locks or in-memory counters.
- Do not run the desktop Playwright suite (`pnpm --filter @rakazo/desktop test:e2e`) locally.
